scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server,worker -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @tracer-ai/client" "npm run dev -w @tracer-ai/server" "npm run dev:worker -w @tracer-ai/server"
scripts.start:production: npm run migrate:sprint-1 -w @tracer-ai/server && npm run migrate:sprint-3 -w @tracer-ai/server && npm run migrate:mvp-completion -w @tracer-ai/server && npm run start -w @tracer-ai/server
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tracer-ai/shared && npm run build -w @tracer-ai/client && npm run build -w @tracer-ai/server
scripts.check: npm run check:architecture && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test && npm run build
